newsitem.title: USA: Dallas Semiconductor sees lower per shr Q3.
newsitem.headline: Dallas Semiconductor sees lower per shr Q3.

text.p: Dallas Semiconductor Corp said on Tuesday it expects third quarter earnings per share to decline from the comparable period last year.
The company said it expect third quarter earnings to be below $0.30 per share versus $0.34 per share in 1995's third quarter.
The decline is being caused largely by higher costs in the company's wafer fabrication facility, the company said.

The company said it has imposed a moratorium on all but essential spending in the wafer fabrication facility. The company said these and other efficiencies should result in margin improvements in 1997.
